cases.input: 今天下午四點開會，請記得帶研究報告。
cases.text: The meeting is at 4 PM this afternoon, please remember to bring the research report.

cases.input: 請不要在星期五開會。報告有三份，不是四份。
cases.text: Please do not have a meeting on Friday. There are three reports, not four.

cases.input: 我明天上午九點到醫院，下午兩點回家。
cases.text: I will go to the hospital at nine o'clock tomorrow morning and return home at two o'clock in the afternoon.
